    name="ground_robocasa365_visual_target",
    entity_name="meat",

    segmentation_id=None,
    world_position=[4.1389, -0.2250, 0.9350],
    prompt="Ground the steak clearly visible directly between the gripper fingers in the eye-in-hand view.",
    query="steak meat"
)

if grounded.ok:
    evidence = grounded.output.get("evidence_handle")
    result = call(
        name="grasp_robocasa365_object",
        object_name="meat",
        evidence_handles=[evidence],
        grasp_approach="near_side",
        grasp_wrist_yaw_offset_rad=0.0,
        gripper_command=1.0,
        horizon=100,
        offset=[0.0, 0.0, -0.015],
        prompt="Close firmly around the steak visible between the fingers, then lift it clear of the cutting board.",
        query="grasp and lift steak"
    )
    print(result.output if result.ok else "steak grasp failed")
else:
    print("steak grounding failed")

    entity_name="counter",

    segmentation_id=None,
    world_position=[4.35, -0.65, 0.95],
    prompt="Ground the clear countertop area to the right of the cutting board for placing the held steak.",
    query="clear counter placement area"
)

if target.ok:
    placement_evidence = target.output.get("evidence_handle")
    result = call(
        name="place_robocasa365_object_at",
        object_name="meat",
        held_object_handle="robocasa:held:12:meat",
        evidence_handles=[placement_evidence],
        gripper_command=-1.0,
        horizon=80,
        offset=[0.0, 0.0, 0.06],
        prompt="Place the held steak on the clear countertop away from the cutting board, then release it.",
        query="remove steak from cutting board"
    )
    print(result.output if result.ok else "steak placement failed")
else:
    print("counter grounding failed")
